requirement: Promote the book’s content across society
proposal_evidence: Tie the proposal narrative and content navigation to the approved book.

requirement: Provide an interactive knowledge and awareness experience using modern technology
proposal_evidence: Show useful interaction with accessible reading and question navigation.

requirement: Make the book easy for participants to benefit from
proposal_evidence: Demonstrate book access on mobile and desktop.

requirement: Ensure fairness and transparency in administration and results
proposal_evidence: Show approval history, scoring explanation and controlled result publication.

requirement: Register with national identity or iqama number to verify eligibility
proposal_evidence: Agree an authoritative verification method; entering an ID alone is insufficient.

requirement: Collect four-part name and primary mobile for OTP
proposal_evidence: Validate understandable fields; separate identity verification from phone control.

requirement: Allow an optional backup mobile
proposal_evidence: Keep it optional; do not silently promote it to an authentication factor.

requirement: Select middle, secondary or university stage
proposal_evidence: Validate one supported stage; clarify category eligibility.

requirement: Record region, governorate, village or center or equivalent
proposal_evidence: Use a controlled hierarchy with an exception path for equivalent localities.

requirement: Accept competition terms before registration completes
proposal_evidence: Record terms version and acceptance; privacy notice and lawful basis remain separate matters.

requirement: Use identity or iqama number to sign in
proposal_evidence: Test both identifiers and numeral entry styles.

requirement: Verify the participant through a code sent to the primary mobile
proposal_evidence: Demonstrate OTP delivery, expiry, rate limits and supported recovery.

requirement: No more than one participation per person
proposal_evidence: Preserve one attempt through refresh, retries and concurrent sessions; clarify season boundary.

requirement: Use only objective questions, such as multiple choice
proposal_evidence: Show supported objective formats; no essay grading in baseline.

requirement: Build questions from the named book
proposal_evidence: Associate each item with approved edition and source location.

requirement: Distribute questions randomly between participants
proposal_evidence: Approve the intended form model and retain each assigned question set.

requirement: Allow returning to a previous question while answering
proposal_evidence: Show backward navigation and preserved answers.

requirement: Allow consulting, opening and downloading the book during participation
proposal_evidence: Demonstrate book use without losing the active attempt.

requirement: Do not show correct answers to participants after the test
proposal_evidence: Verify absence from visible UI, network responses and exports available to participants.

requirement: Allow participation throughout the competition period without a time limit for answering
proposal_evidence: No attempt countdown; distinguish campaign closing date and security session expiry.

requirement: Calculate results electronically and automatically
proposal_evidence: Use reproducible scoring over a saved final answer set.

requirement: Announce winners based on the highest achieved scores
proposal_evidence: Use the approved award scope and categories, not assumed quotas.

requirement: Do not use time to distinguish equal scores
proposal_evidence: Show a tie test in which elapsed time and submission time do not affect rank.

requirement: Use a fair tie-resolution mechanism determined by organizers when needed
proposal_evidence: Keep tied cases unresolved until a documented organizer-approved rule is available.

requirement: Export results and statistical reports electronically
proposal_evidence: Provide authorized exports that match the approved scoring snapshot.

requirement: Manage participant data and results
proposal_evidence: Demonstrate roles and logged changes.

requirement: Manage and update the question bank
proposal_evidence: Use controlled versions and an approved mid-competition correction policy.

requirement: Track complete and incomplete participations
proposal_evidence: Define completion states and verify counts.

requirement: Send automated reminders to incomplete participants without excessive alerts
proposal_evidence: Use approved cadence, deduplication and cancellation after completion.

requirement: Produce required reports and statistics
proposal_evidence: Demonstrate all required report families.

requirement: Total participants by educational stage
proposal_evidence: Reconcile stage subtotals with the eligible reporting population.

requirement: Participants by cities, governorates, villages or centers
proposal_evidence: Resolve the city/reporting versus region/registration field mismatch.

requirement: Counts of complete and incomplete participations
proposal_evidence: Use explicit reporting definitions and an as-of timestamp.

requirement: Winners and final grades
proposal_evidence: Restrict access and publish only approved winner fields.

requirement: General statistical report including the preceding reports
proposal_evidence: Provide a consistent summary using the same filters and snapshot.

requirement: Send verification code at registration
proposal_evidence: Test code delivery and distinguish it from registration success.

requirement: Send registration confirmation messages
proposal_evidence: Send only after completed registration.

requirement: Send reminders for incomplete participations
proposal_evidence: Share reminder policy with R29 rather than duplicate sends.

requirement: Send winner congratulations and result announcement notifications
proposal_evidence: Trigger from approved release, not provisional calculation.

requirement: Male and female students in middle, secondary and university stages
proposal_evidence: Cover specified populations in discovery and usability evaluation.

requirement: Include government, private and international schools and accredited universities/colleges
proposal_evidence: Agree how institution eligibility is checked without excluding international schools.

requirement: Design compatible with smart devices and computers
proposal_evidence: Evaluate realistic small screens and desktop use.

requirement: Easy-to-use Arabic interface
proposal_evidence: Test Arabic copy, RTL layout, keyboard and assistive technology.

requirement: Protect participant data and privacy
proposal_evidence: Map collected fields, permissions, retention and applicable legal controls.

requirement: Keep data backups
proposal_evidence: Demonstrate a restore, not just backup configuration.

requirement: Allow future expansion and development
proposal_evidence: Document extensibility and ownership without promising unnecessary features.

requirement: Provide technical support throughout the competition
proposal_evidence: Agree coverage dates, channels, escalation and incident authority.
